citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.302. Appropriation (2023)
content:
Following the expiration of one or more generation rate caps established in an electric
   utility restructuring proceeding under66 Pa.C.S. § 2804(4)(relating to standards for restructuring of electric industry), an amount not to
   exceed $40,000,000 shall be annually appropriated from the General Fund to the authority.  The authority shall use the funds to incur indebtedness under this section in an
   amount up to $500,000,000 plus the payment of all reasonable costs and expenses related
   to the issuance of indebtedness in accordance with 64 Pa.C.S. Ch. 15 (relating to
   Commonwealth Financing Authority) for up to 30 years.  For fiscal years 2008-2009 through 2037-2038, the $40,000,000 appropriated under
   this section, or as much thereof as may be necessary, shall be used by the authority
   for payment of debt service.  Proceeds from any debt incurred under this section shall be allocated in accordance
   with this chapter.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act›Chapter 7. Alternative Energy Production Tax Credit Program›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.705. Carryover, refund, assignment and carryback of credit
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act › Chapter 7. Alternative Energy Production Tax Credit Program › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.705. Carryover, refund, assignment and carryback of credit
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.705. Carryover, refund, assignment and carryback of credit (2023)
content:
(a) Carryover.--If the taxpayer cannot use the entire amount of the alternative energy production
      tax credit for the taxable year in which the alternative energy production tax credit
      is first approved, the excess may be carried over to succeeding taxable years and
      used as a credit against the qualified tax liability of the taxpayer for those taxable
      years.  Each time that the alternative energy production tax credit is carried over to a
      succeeding taxable year, it is to be reduced by the amount that was used as a credit
      during the immediately preceding taxable year.  The alternative energy production tax credit provided under this chapter may be
      carried over and applied to succeeding taxable years for no more than five taxable
      years following the first taxable year for which the taxpayer was entitled to claim
      the credit.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act › Chapter 7. Alternative Energy Production Tax Credit Program › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.709. Termination
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.709. Termination (2023)
content:
The department shall not approve an alternative energy production tax credit under
   this chapter for taxable years ending after December 31, 2016.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act›Chapter 7. Alternative Energy Production Tax Credit Program›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.708. Reporting
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act › Chapter 7. Alternative Energy Production Tax Credit Program › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.708. Reporting
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.708. Reporting (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--No later than September 1 of each year, the department, in consultation with the Department
      of Revenue, shall submit a report to the General Assembly summarizing the effectiveness
      of the tax credit provided under this chapter.  The report shall include the name of each taxpayer utilizing the credit as of the
      date of the report and the amount of credits approved for or utilized by each taxpayer.  The report may also include recommendation for changes in the calculation or administration
      of the tax credit.  The report shall be submitted to the chairman and minority chairman of the Appropriations
      Committee of the Senate, the chairman and minority chairman of the Finance Committee
      of the Senate, the chairman and minority chairman of the Appropriations Committee
      of the House of Representatives and the chairman and minority chairman of the Finance
      Committee of the House of Representatives.  The report shall include the following information, which shall be separated by
      geographic location within this Commonwealth:

content: This chapter shall apply as follows:

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act › Chapter 7. Alternative Energy Production Tax Credit Program › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.707. Pass-through entity
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.707. Pass-through entity (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If a pass-through entity has any unused tax credit under section 705,1the entity may elect, in writing, according to the department's procedures, to transfer
      all or a portion of the credit to shareholders, members or partners in proportion
      to the share of the entity's distributive income to which the shareholder, member
      or partner is entitled.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act › Chapter 29. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.2901. Effective date
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.2901. Effective date (2023)
content: This act shall take effect immediately.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act›Chapter 7. Alternative Energy Production Tax Credit Program›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.710. Regulations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18G. Alternative Energy Investment Act › Chapter 7. Alternative Energy Production Tax Credit Program › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1649.710. Regulations

The department, in cooperation with the Department of Revenue, shall promulgate regulations
   necessary for the implementation and administration of this chapter.

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.3. Biodiesel content in diesel fuel sold for on-road use (2023)
content: (a) Volume standards.--The following standards shall apply:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.4. Cellulosic ethanol content in gasoline
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.4. Cellulosic ethanol content in gasoline
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.4. Cellulosic ethanol content in gasoline (2023)
content:
(a) Cellulosic ethanol content required.--All gasoline sold or offered for sale to ultimate consumers in this Commonwealth must
      contain at least 10% cellulosic ethanol by volume as determined by an appropriate
      Environmental Protection Agency or American Society for Testing Materials standard
      method of analysis one year after the in-State production volume of 350,000,000 gallons
      of cellulosic ethanol has been reached and sustained for three months on an annualized
      basis as determined by the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.1. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.1. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.1. Short title (2023)
content:
This act shall be known and may be cited as the Biofuel Development and In-State Production
   Incentive Act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 21. Inspectors and Weighers›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1755. Tests and adjustment or removal and destruction of new scales, weights and measures
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 21. Inspectors and Weighers › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1755. Tests and adjustment or removal and destruction of new scales, weights and measures
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1755. Tests and adjustment or removal and destruction of new scales, weights and measures (2023)
content:
Any person or persons purchasing new scales, weights or measures that do not contain
   the stamp of the inspector shall, before using them, notify the inspector of the district
   and have them tested, and all scales, weights or measures that cannot be adjusted
   by the inspector shall be removed and destroyed.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 21. Inspectors and Weighers›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1756. Refusal to allow inspection
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 21. Inspectors and Weighers › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1756. Refusal to allow inspection
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1756. Refusal to allow inspection (2023)
content:
Any person, upon arrest and conviction before a magistrate or justice of the peace
   for refusing to allow his scales, weights and measures to be inspected, shall be fined
   ten dollars and costs of court, or be sentenced to imprisonment for a period of not
   more than ten days.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.2. Definitions

content:
The following words and phrases when used in this act shall have the meanings given
   to them in this section unless the context clearly indicates otherwise:

content: (a) Blending requirements.--The following requirements shall apply:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 21. Inspectors and Weighers›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1757. Alteration of, or substitution for, inspected scales, etc.; penalties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 21. Inspectors and Weighers › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1757. Alteration of, or substitution for, inspected scales, etc.; penalties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1757. Alteration of, or substitution for, inspected scales, etc.; penalties (2023)
content:
Any person who shall, after his scales, weights and measures have been inspected in
   accordance with the provisions of the fifth section of this act,1alter or cause to be altered his said inspected scales, weights and measures so that
   they be decreased in size or amount, or who shall substitute for said inspected weights
   and measures any other weights and measures of smaller size or amount, shall, upon
   arrest and conviction before a magistrate or justice of the peace, be fined not more
   than twenty dollars and cost of court, and in default of the payment of such fine
   and costs shall be imprisoned for a period of not more than ten days.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 23. Time›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1803. Act to apply to ordinances, etc., of municipal and other corporations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 23. Time › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1803. Act to apply to ordinances, etc., of municipal and other corporations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1803. Act to apply to ordinances, etc., of municipal and other corporations (2023)
content:
The provisions of this act shall also apply to the ordinances, resolutions, by-laws
   and other regulations of all municipal or other public or private corporations now
   existing or hereafter created.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.6. Infrastructure reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.6. Infrastructure reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.6. Infrastructure reports (2023)
content:
(a) Certification.--At least six months prior to the effective dates of the mandated content requirements
      contained in sections 3(a)(1), (2), (3) and (4) and 4,1the department and the Department of Transportation shall jointly make a certification
      as to whether there is sufficient transportation, distribution and other necessary
      infrastructure, including rail capability and terminal facilities, in this Commonwealth
      to meet the requirements of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 23. Time›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1802. Computation of time
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 23. Time › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1802. Computation of time
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1802. Computation of time (2023)
content:
Where by any existing law or rule of court, or by any law or rule of court that may
   hereafter be enacted and made, the performance or doing of any act, duty, matter,
   payment or thing shall be ordered and directed, and where any court shall, by special
   or other order, direct the performance or doing of any act, matter, payment, sentence
   or decree, and the period of time or duration for the performance or doing thereof
   shall be prescribed and fixed, such time in all cases shall be so computed as to exclude
   the first, and include the last days of any such prescribed or fixed period, or duration
   of time:  Provided, That whenever the last day of any such period shall fall on Saturday
   or Sunday, or on any day made a legal holiday by the laws of this Commonwealth, or
   of the United States, such day shall be omitted from the computation:  And provided,
   That this act shall not apply to the payment of negotiable paper.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.7. National Ambient Air Quality Standards impact study
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.7. National Ambient Air Quality Standards impact study
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.7. National Ambient Air Quality Standards impact study (2023)
content:
(a) Contracts.--The Department of Environmental Protection shall contract with an independent third
      party certified in conducting ambient air quality studies to determine the impact
      of this act on the Commonwealth's ability to achieve and maintain the National Ambient
      Air Quality Standards.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.5. Department authority and responsibility
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.5. Department authority and responsibility
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.5. Department authority and responsibility (2023)
content:
(a) Enforcement.--With the exception of section 3(d),1the department shall enforce this act and shall promulgate regulations as necessary
      to implement and enforce the requirements of this act.  The department may employ all proper means for the enforcement of this act, including
      issuing notices and orders, initiating criminal prosecutions, seeking injunctive relief,
      imposing civil penalties and entering into consent agreements.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.20. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 18H. Biofuel Development and In-State Production Incentive Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.20. Effective date
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1650.20. Effective date (2023)
content: This act shall take effect in 90 days.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Black Blasting Powder›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1823. Use of stamped kegs by others than parties named unlawful
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Black Blasting Powder › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1823. Use of stamped kegs by others than parties named unlawful
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1823. Use of stamped kegs by others than parties named unlawful (2023)
content:
It shall not be lawful for any other person, firm or corporation, save only such person,
   firm or corporation whose name shall be stamped on said kegs, to use any such stamped
   keg for the purpose of containing said black blasting powder.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Black Blasting Powder›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1825. Repeals
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Black Blasting Powder › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1825. Repeals
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1825. Repeals (2023)
content: All acts or parts of acts inconsistent herewith are hereby repealed.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Black Blasting Powder›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1821. Weight and stamping of kegs
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Black Blasting Powder › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1821. Weight and stamping of kegs
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1821. Weight and stamping of kegs (2023)
content:
On and after the first day of August, Anno Domini one thousand nine hundred and one,
   each and every keg of black blasting powder used, manufactured or sold in and around
   the coal mines of this Commonwealth, shall contain twenty-five pounds of said black
   blasting powder, standard weight;  every one-half keg shall contain twelve and a half
   pounds of said black blasting powder, standard weight, and every quarter keg shall
   contain six and one-quarter pounds of said black blasting powder, standard weight;
   each of said kegs to be plainly stamped with the name of the person, firm or corporation
   manufacturing said powder, and also the number of pounds of powder contained in said
   keg.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 23. Time›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1801. Uniform standard time
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 23. Time › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1801. Uniform standard time
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1801. Uniform standard time (2023)
content:
(a) On and after the first day of July, Anno Domini one thousand eight hundred and
      eighty-seven, the mean solar time of the seventy-fifth meridian of longitude west
      of Greenwich, commonly called eastern standard time, shall be the sole and uniform
      legal standard of time throughout this Commonwealth;  and on and after the date aforesaid
      all days shall everywhere be taken to begin and end in accordance with said standard;
      and every mention of, or reference to, any hour or time in any and all existing future
      acts of Assembly, municipal ordinances, and corporate bylaws, in any and all existing
      or future rules or regulations adopted by any public officer or official board, in
      any and all rules of the courts of the Commonwealth or any of them, whether standing
      or special, and whether now in force or hereafter to be promulgated, in any and all
      orders, judgments and decrees of said courts or any of them, and judgments and sentences
      of magistrates pronounced or entered on or after the date aforesaid, in any and all
      contracts, deeds, wills, and notices, and in the transaction of all matters of business,
      public, legal, commercial, or otherwise,--shall be construed with reference to, and
      in accordance with, the said standard hereby adopted, unless a different standard
      is therein expressly provided for:  Provided, however, That this act shall not operate
      to impose upon any person any forfeiture of rights, or subject him to the consequences
      of any default, by reason of any failure, occurring prior to the date aforesaid, to
      comply with the requirement of, or do any act under or in pursuance of any law, ordinance,
      contract, notice, deed, will, regulation, rule, order, judgment, sentence, or decree,
      if such person shall, before the said date, have properly done the act or acts which
      would be requisite to save such forfeiture or prevent such default had this law not
      been enacted:  And provided, further, That when the standard time shall be advanced,
      for any portion of the year, by any act of Congress, now in force or hereafter passed,
      the time so fixed by such act of Congress shall be the standard time of this Commonwealth
      for such portion of the year:  And provided, That no county, city, borough, town,
      township, or other municipal subdivision of the Commonwealth shall, by ordinance,
      resolution, or rule, adopt a different standard of time for any year, or any portion
      of the year, than that herein provided;  and all ordinances, resolutions and rules
      heretofore adopted, contrary to this proviso, are declared to be void and of no effect.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Hay and Straw›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1862. Weight of baling material; use of wood
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Hay and Straw › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1862. Weight of baling material; use of wood
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1862. Weight of baling material; use of wood (2023)
content:
The wood or other material used in baling cut hay shall not exceed in weight eight
   per centum of the weight of the entire bundle, and no wood, except for a marking block,
   shall be used in baling long hay or straw.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Black Blasting Powder›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1822. Penalty for violation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Black Blasting Powder › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1822. Penalty for violation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1822. Penalty for violation (2023)
content:
Any manufacturer or dealer in said black blasting powder, making or selling, or causing
   to be made or sold, any keg, half-keg or quarter-keg of said black blasting powder
   containing less weight of said powder than specified in this act, or which keg shall
   not be stamped as required in section one of this act,1shall be subject to a penalty of five dollars for each and every keg, half-keg or
   quarter-keg, manufactured or sold, which does not contain the respective weights of
   black blasting powder set forth in the foregoing section.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Hay and Straw›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1861. Bales to be properly bound and marked with correct weight
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Hay and Straw › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1861. Bales to be properly bound and marked with correct weight
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1861. Bales to be properly bound and marked with correct weight (2023)
content:
Hereafter all baled hay and straw shall be properly bound with wire, rope or other
   material to hold it in bundle, and the correct weight shall be plainly marked on each
   bale.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Black Blasting Powder›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1824. Penalty for wrongful use
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Black Blasting Powder › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1824. Penalty for wrongful use
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1824. Penalty for wrongful use (2023)
content:
Any person, firm or corporation violating the provisions of section three of this
   act1shall be subject to a fine of not less than five hundred dollars ($500) nor more
   than one thousand dollars ($1,000).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Wood and Charcoal›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1872. Standard log rule
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Wood and Charcoal › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1872. Standard log rule
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1872. Standard log rule (2023)
content:
The Scribner log rule is hereby adopted as the standard log rule for determining the
   board foot content of saw logs;  and all contracts hereafter entered into for the
   cutting, purchase and sale of saw logs shall be deemed to be made on the basis of
   such standard rule unless some other method of measurement is specifically agreed
   upon.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Wood and Charcoal›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1871. Bark; weight of cord and ton
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Wood and Charcoal › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1871. Bark; weight of cord and ton
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1871. Bark; weight of cord and ton (2023)
content:
From and after the passage of this act the standard weight of a cord of hemlock, oak
   or other bark, when sold by the cord or ton, shall be two thousand pounds for each
   and every cord, and two thousand pounds for each and every ton.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Hay and Straw›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1863. Violation a misdemeanor; penalty
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Hay and Straw › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1863. Violation a misdemeanor; penalty
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1863. Violation a misdemeanor; penalty (2023)
content:
Any person who shall mark a bale of hay or straw higher than its actual weight, or
   who shall use more than eight per centum of its weight of wood or other material to
   hold it in bundle, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor, and on conviction thereof shall
   be fined not less than twenty-five dollars nor more than one hundred dollars, in the
   discretion of the court before whom conviction may be secured.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.1. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.1. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.1. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known and may be cited as the Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.3. Transfer of rights
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.3. Transfer of rights
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.3. Transfer of rights (2023)
content:
Unless otherwise agreed in writing, if a customer does not claim possession of a die,
   mold or form from the molder within three years from the last use of the die, mold
   or form, all rights, title and interest in the die, mold or form may, at the option
   of the molder, be transferred by operation of law to the molder for purposes of destroying
   the die, mold or form.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.5. Customer's rights
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.5. Customer's rights
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.5. Customer's rights (2023)
content:
If a customer does not claim possession of the die, mold or form within 120 days after
   the date the molder receives the return receipt of the notice sent pursuant to section
   41or does not make other arrangements with the molder for storage of the die, mold
   or form within the time limit established in this section, all rights, title and interest
   of the customer in the die, mold or form shall be transferred by operation of law
   to the molder for purposes of destroying the die, mold or form.  This section shall not be construed to affect a right of a customer under Federal
   patent or copyright law or any Federal or State law pertaining to unfair competition.

content:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.4. Notice
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.4. Notice
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.4. Notice (2023)
content:
After the expiration of the three-year period set forth in section 3,1if a molder chooses to have all rights, title and interest in a die, mold or form
   transferred to the molder by operation of law, the molder shall send written notice
   by registered mail, return receipt requested, to an address designated in writing
   by the customer or, if not so designated, to the customer's last known address, indicating
   that the molder intends to terminate the customer's rights, title and interest in
   the die, mold or form by having all rights, title and interest in the die, mold or
   form transferred to the molder by operation of law under this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.7. Liens
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.7. Liens
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.7. Liens (2023)
content:
(a) Lien;  possession.--Molders shall have a lien, dependent on possession, on all dies, molds or forms in
      their hands belonging to a customer for the balance due them from such customer for
      any manufacturing or fabrication work and in the value of all material related to
      such work.  The molder may retain possession of the die, mold or form until the charges are
      paid.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.10. Effective date

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.10. Effective date (2023)
content: This act shall take effect immediately.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.9. Exceptions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.9. Exceptions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.9. Exceptions (2023)
content:
This act shall not apply if a molder retains title to and possession of a die, mold
   or form.  This act shall not be construed to grant a customer rights, title or interest in
   a die, mold or form.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1882. Police power
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1882. Police power
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1882. Police power (2023)
content:
This act shall be deemed to be an exercise of the police powers of the Commonwealth
   for the protection of the health, safety and general welfare of the people of the
   Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1885. Payments under contracts; action to recover unauthorized payments; prohibitions for violations; procedure
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1885. Payments under contracts; action to recover unauthorized payments; prohibitions for violations; procedure
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1885. Payments under contracts; action to recover unauthorized payments; prohibitions for violations; procedure (2023)
content:
(a) No public agency shall authorize, provide for or make any payments to any person
      under any contract containing the provision required by section 41unless, when unidentified steel products are supplied under a contract, such person
      has provided documentation including, but not limited to, invoices, bills of lading,
      and mill certification that the steel was melted and manufactured in the United States,
      which establish that such person has fully complied with such provision.  If a steel product is identifiable from its face, such person must submit certification
      which satisfies the public agency that such person has fully complied with the provision
      required by section 4.  Any such payments made to any person by any public agency which should not have
      been made as a result of this section shall be recoverable directly from the contractor,
      subcontractor, manufacturer or supplier who did not comply with section 4 by either
      such public agency or the Attorney General of Pennsylvania.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1881. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1881. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1881. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known and may be cited as the “Steel Products Procurement Act.”

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.8. Notice of sale (2023)
content:
(a) Notice requirements.--Before a molder may sell the die, mold or form, the molder shall notify the customer
      by registered mail, return receipt requested.  The notice shall include the following information:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities›Specific Articles›Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.6. Waiting period retroactive
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 24. Mining, Manufacture and Sale of Commodities › Specific Articles › Die, Mold and Form Forfeiture Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.6. Waiting period retroactive
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1880.6. Waiting period retroactive (2023)
content:
The three-year waiting period provided in section 31shall apply retroactively in the case of a die, mold or form in the possession of
   a molder on the effective date of this section.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1884. Required contract provisions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1884. Required contract provisions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1884. Required contract provisions (2023)
content:
(a) Every public agency shall require that every contract document for the construction,
      reconstruction, alteration, repair, improvement or maintenance of public works contain
      a provision that, if any steel products are to be used or supplied in the performance
      of the contract, only steel products as herein defined shall be used or supplied in
      the performance of the contract or any subcontracts thereunder.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1888. Repeals
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1888. Repeals
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1888. Repeals (2023)
content: All acts or parts of acts are repealed insofar as they are inconsistent herewith.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1887. Purpose of act; liberal construction
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1887. Purpose of act; liberal construction
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1887. Purpose of act; liberal construction (2023)
content:
This act is intended as remedial legislation designed to promote the general welfare
   and stimulate the economy of the Commonwealth and its people and each and every provision
   hereof is intended to receive a liberal construction such as will best effectuate
   that purpose and no provision is intended to receive a strict or limited construction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1889. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 25. Steel Products Procurement Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1889. Effective date

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1901. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1901. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known and may be cited as the “Self-Service Storage Facility Act.”

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1904. Owner's lien
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1904. Owner's lien
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1904. Owner's lien (2023)
content:
(a) Owner's lien.--The owner of a self-service storage facility and his heirs, executors, administrators,
      successors and assigns shall have a lien upon all personal property, while located
      at a self-service storage facility, for rent, labor, late fees or other charges, present
      or future, incurred for storing said property, and for expenses necessary for its
      preservation or expenses reasonably incurred in its sale or other disposition pursuant
      to this act.  The lien provided for in this section is superior to any other lien or security
      interest;  however any lien existing prior to the date the personal property was placed
      at the self-service storage facility supersedes any lien of the owner.  The lien attaches as of the date the personal property is placed at the self-service
      storage facility and the rental agreement shall contain a statement in bold type notifying
      the occupant of the existence of the lien.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1910. Conformance with notice
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1910. Conformance with notice
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1910. Conformance with notice (2023)
content:
(a) Conformance with terms.--Any sale or other disposition of the personal property shall conform to the terms
      of the notification as provided for in this section.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1903. Access
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1903. Access
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1903. Access (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Upon the reasonable request of the owner, the occupant shall provide access to the
      owner to enter the leased space for the purposes of inspection, repair, alteration,
      improvement or to supply necessary or agreed services.  In case of emergency, the owner may enter the leased space for any of the above
      stated purposes without notice to or consent from the occupant.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1906. Notice
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1906. Notice
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1906. Notice (2023)
content:
(a) Service.--The owner shall give written notice of the default and any other action taken in regard
      to the occupant's property, to the occupant by personal service, verified mail, electronic
      mail or by certified mail, return receipt requested, sent to the occupant's last known
      address.  A notice shall be presumed to be served when it is deposited with the United States
      Postal Service or private delivery service and properly addressed with postage prepaid
      or by electronic mail to an electronic mailing address provided by the occupant.  For purposes of notice of default, electronic mail may be used to notify an occupant
      of the default only if all of the following apply:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1913. Excess balance from sale
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1913. Excess balance from sale
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1913. Excess balance from sale (2023)
content:
In the event of a sale under this section, the owner may satisfy his lien from the
   proceeds of the sale but shall hold the balance, if any, for delivery on demand to
   the occupant.  If the occupant does not claim the balance of the proceeds within six months of
   the date of the sale, such balance shall be deemed to be abandoned and the owner shall
   pay such balance to the Secretary of Revenue who shall receive, hold and dispose of
   same in accordance with Article XIII.1 of the act of April 9, 1929 (P.L. 343, No.
   176), known as “The Fiscal Code.”1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1905. Enforcement of lien
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1905. Enforcement of lien
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1905. Enforcement of lien (2023)
content:
(a) Default.--No enforcement action shall be taken by the owner until the occupant has been in default
      continuously for a period of 30 days.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1908. Location of sale
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1908. Location of sale
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1908. Location of sale (2023)
content:
Any sale or other disposition of the personal property shall be held at the self-service
   storage facility, online or at the nearest suitable place to where the personal property
   is held or stored.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1907. Advertisement of sale
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1907. Advertisement of sale
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1907. Advertisement of sale (2023)
content:
(a) Publication.--After the expiration of the time stated in the notice and if the personal property
      has not otherwise been disposed of, the owner shall cause an advertisement of sale
      to be published either:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1911. Title to goods purchased
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1911. Title to goods purchased
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1911. Title to goods purchased (2023)
content:
A purchaser in good faith of the personal property sold to satisfy the owner's lien
   takes the property free of any rights of persons against whom the lien was valid,
   despite noncompliance by the owner with the requirements of this section.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1932. License required
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1932. License required
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1932. License required (2023)
content:
(a) Dealer.--A dealer in precious metals shall obtain a license from the sheriff of each and every
      county in which the dealer purchases precious metals.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1912. Right of owner to purchase
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1912. Right of owner to purchase
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1912. Right of owner to purchase (2023)
content: The owner may buy at any sale of personal property to enforce the owner's lien.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1915. Limitation on liability of owner
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1915. Limitation on liability of owner
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1915. Limitation on liability of owner (2023)
content:
(a) Sale or removal.--An owner shall not be liable to an occupant or a third party for the removal or sale
      of personal property which is not the property of the occupant or upon which a prior
      lien has attached, unless notice shall have been given to the owner by the occupant
      that the property placed in the leased space was not that of the occupant.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1917. Savings clause
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1917. Savings clause
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1917. Savings clause (2023)
content:
All rental agreements entered into before the effective date of this act, and not
   extended or renewed after that date, and the rights and duties and interests flowing
   from them shall remain valid, and may be enforced or terminated in accordance with
   their terms or as permitted by any other statute or law of this Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1914. Care, custody and control
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1914. Care, custody and control
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1914. Care, custody and control (2023)
content:
Unless the rental agreement specifically provides otherwise, the exclusive care, custody
   and control of any and all personal property stored in the leased space shall remain
   vested in the occupant, who shall bear all risks of loss or damage to such property
   not caused by any negligence of the owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1931. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1931. Definitions

content:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1916. Construction of act
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1916. Construction of act
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1916. Construction of act (2023)
content:
Nothing in this act shall be construed as in any manner impairing or affecting the
   right of the parties to create additional rights, duties and obligations in and by
   virtue of the rental agreement.  The rights provided by this act shall be in addition to all other rights allowed
   by law to a creditor against his debtor.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1909. Payment and satisfaction
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1909. Payment and satisfaction
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1909. Payment and satisfaction (2023)
content:
Before any sale or other disposition of personal property, the occupant may pay the
   amount necessary to satisfy the owner's lien and other reasonable expenses incurred
   hereunder and thereby redeem the personal property.  Upon the payment and satisfaction of the amount necessary to satisfy the owner's
   lien and the reasonable expenses incurred, the owner shall return the personal property
   and the owner shall thereafter have no liability to any person with respect to such
   personal property.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1918. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 26. Self-Service Storage Facilities › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1918. Effective date
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1918. Effective date (2023)
content:
This act shall take effect in 60 days and shall apply to all rental agreements executed
   or renewed on and after that date.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1935. Purchases from minors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1935. Purchases from minors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1935. Purchases from minors (2023)
content:
The dealer in precious metals shall require any minor seeking to sell precious metals
   to produce written authority of a parent, guardian or person in loco parentis authorizing
   the sale of such precious metals.  Such authorization shall give the name and address of authorizing person.  The dealer in precious metals shall verify that such sale is authorized by inquiry
   of such parent, guardian or person in loco parentis.  Minors shall be required to wait three full working days before receiving payment
   from the sale of precious metals.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1936. Posting of prices
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1936. Posting of prices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1936. Posting of prices (2023)
content:
Prices for the purchase of precious metals shall be posted by the dealer in precious
   metals in compliance with rules and regulations promulgated or to be promulgated by
   the Department of Agriculture.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1934. Dealer's retention of precious metal and availability for inspection
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1934. Dealer's retention of precious metal and availability for inspection
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1934. Dealer's retention of precious metal and availability for inspection (2023)
content:
(a) Precious metal to be retained for five days.--Each item of precious metal purchased by a dealer in precious metals shall be retained
      in unaltered condition for five full working days after report of its purchase has
      been filed with the proper district attorney or his designee.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1933. Records of transactions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1933. Records of transactions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1933. Records of transactions (2023)
content:
(a) Dealers to keep record.--Every dealer in precious metals shall keep a record of every transaction upon a form
      approved by the Attorney General.  The record shall include as a minimum:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1939. Inspection of licensee
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 27. Purchase and Sale of Precious Metals › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1939. Inspection of licensee
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1939. Inspection of licensee (2023)
content:
The acceptance of a license by a dealer in precious metals implies consent to inspections
   of his, her or its premises by law enforcement officials and officials authorized
   to enforce laws and regulations pertaining to weights and measures.  Such inspections shall pertain to items of precious metals and to scales and weighing
   or measuring devices.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 27A. Scrap Material Theft Prevention Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1943.6a. Statewide registry of scrap processors and recycling facilities
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 27A. Scrap Material Theft Prevention Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1943.6a. Statewide registry of scrap processors and recycling facilities
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1943.6a. Statewide registry of scrap processors and recycling facilities (2023)
content:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 28. Automobile Lemon Law›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1955. Manufacturer's duty for refund or replacement
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 28. Automobile Lemon Law › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1955. Manufacturer's duty for refund or replacement
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1955. Manufacturer's duty for refund or replacement (2023)
content:
If the manufacturer fails to repair or correct a nonconformity after a reasonable
   number of attempts, the manufacturer shall, at the option of the purchaser, replace
   the motor vehicle with a comparable motor vehicle of equal value or accept return
   of the vehicle from the purchaser and refund to the purchaser the full purchase price
   or lease price, including all collateral charges, less a reasonable allowance for
   the purchaser's use of the vehicle not exceeding 10¢ per mile driven or 10% of the
   purchase price or lease price of the vehicle, whichever is less.  Refunds shall be made to the purchaser and lienholder, if any, as their interests
   may appear.  A reasonable allowance for use shall be that amount directly attributable to use
   by the purchaser prior to his first report of the nonconformity to the manufacturer.  In the event the consumer elects a refund, payment shall be made within 30 days
   of such election.  A consumer shall not be entitled to a refund or replacement if the nonconformity
   does not substantially impair the use, value or safety of the vehicle or the nonconformity
   is the result of abuse, neglect or modification or alteration of the motor vehicle
   by the purchaser.  For purposes of this section, the phrase“modification or alteration”shall include, in relation to a motorcycle, a modification or alteration made after
   the date of actual delivery of the motorcycle to the purchaser.

content:

   all work performed on said vehicle including, but not limited to, parts and labor.  It shall be the duty of a dealer to notify the manufacturer of the existence of

   to a nonconformity when it is delivered to the same dealer for the second time for
   repair of the same nonconformity.  The notification shall be by certified mail, return receipt requested.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 29. Jewelry Appraisal Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1984. Penalty
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 29. Jewelry Appraisal Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1984. Penalty
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1984. Penalty (2023)
content:
A jeweler who violates the provisions of this act commits a summary offense and shall,
   upon conviction, be sentenced to pay a fine of $100 for the first offense and $200
   for the second or any subsequent offense.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 29. Jewelry Appraisal Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1985. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 29. Jewelry Appraisal Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1985. Effective date
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1985. Effective date (2023)
content: This act shall take effect in 60 days.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 29. Jewelry Appraisal Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1981. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 29. Jewelry Appraisal Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1981. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1981. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known and may be cited as the Jewelry Appraisal Act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Magazine Solicitation›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2012. Application for license
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Magazine Solicitation › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2012. Application for license
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2012. Application for license (2023)
content:
An application for such a license shall include a statement that the applicant or
   any of its officers or employes have not been convicted of any crime.  Such application shall include the names and addresses of all officers and employes
   of such applicant, and the names and addresses of all officers and employes of any
   franchise dealer of such applicant.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Contracts›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2001. Unsolicited goods
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Contracts › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2001. Unsolicited goods
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2001. Unsolicited goods (2023)
content:
Unless otherwise agreed between the sender and the recipient of the goods prior to
   delivery, where unsolicited goods are delivered to a person, he has a right to refuse
   to accept delivery of the goods and is not bound to return such goods to the sender.  If such unsolicited goods are sent by mail to and intended for the recipient, they
   shall be deemed a gift to the recipient, who may use them or dispose of them in any
   manner without any obligation to the sender.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 29. Jewelry Appraisal Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 1983. Appraisal costs
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 29. Jewelry Appraisal Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 1983. Appraisal costs
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 1983. Appraisal costs (2023)
content:
Any jeweler who conducts appraisals of pieces of jewelry for a fee shall charge a
   flat rate.  No jeweler may make an appraisal in which his appraisal cost or fee is based upon
   the value or apparent value of the item sought to be appraised.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Magazine Solicitation›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2015. Change in officers or employes; supplementary data
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Magazine Solicitation › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2015. Change in officers or employes; supplementary data
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2015. Change in officers or employes; supplementary data (2023)
content:
Any individual, partnership, corporation, association or other group which has been
   granted such a license shall, during the term of such license, file supplementary
   data with the Attorney General whenever there is a change in the list of officers
   or employes of such licensee stating that any such new officers or employes have not
   been convicted of any crime.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Magazine Solicitation›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2014. License fee
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Magazine Solicitation › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2014. License fee
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2014. License fee (2023)
content: The annual fee for such license shall be one hundred dollars ($100).

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Magazine Solicitation›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2011. Magazine subscriptions; solicitation; license; exceptions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Magazine Solicitation › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2011. Magazine subscriptions; solicitation; license; exceptions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2011. Magazine subscriptions; solicitation; license; exceptions (2023)
content:
No individual, partnership, corporation, association or other group shall solicit
   the subscription of any magazine within this Commonwealth by the use of door-to-door
   salesmen without first obtaining a license from the Attorney General;  provided that
   the provisions of this act shall not apply to any charitable or non-profit organization
   which solicits the subscription of magazines by the use of door-to-door salesmen.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Magazine Solicitation›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2013. Rules and regulations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Magazine Solicitation › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2013. Rules and regulations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2013. Rules and regulations (2023)
content:
The Attorney General is hereby authorized and directed to promulgate such reasonable
   rules and regulations as shall be necessary for the administration and enforcement
   of this act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Gaming Transactions›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2031. Gaming contracts to be void
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Gaming Transactions › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2031. Gaming contracts to be void
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2031. Gaming contracts to be void (2023)
content:
If any person or persons shall lose any money or other valuable thing, at or upon
   any match of cock-fighting, bullet-playing, or horse-racing, or at or upon any game
   of address, game of hazard, play or game whatsoever, the person or persons who shall
   lose their money or other valuable thing shall not be compelled to pay or make good
   the same;  and every contract, note, bill, bond, judgment, mortgage, or other security
   or conveyance whatsoever, given, granted, drawn or entered into for the security or
   satisfaction of the same, or any part thereof, shall be utterly void and of none effect.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Magazine Solicitation›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2017. Violations; penalty
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Magazine Solicitation › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2017. Violations; penalty
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2017. Violations; penalty (2023)
content:
Any person who wilfully and intentionally violates, or shall direct or consent to
   the violation of any provision of this act, or who knowingly provides any false information
   to the Attorney General, shall be guilty of a misdemeanor and upon conviction shall
   be punished by a fine of not more than one thousand dollars ($1,000) or by imprisonment
   for not more than six months, or both.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Magazine Solicitation›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2016. Subscriptions obtained without license; enforceability
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Magazine Solicitation › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2016. Subscriptions obtained without license; enforceability
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2016. Subscriptions obtained without license; enforceability (2023)
content:
Any contract for the subscription of any magazine solicited by use of door-to-door
   salesmen by any individual, partnership, corporation, association or other group without
   first obtaining a license as provided in this act, or while any such individual, partnership,
   corporation, association or other group was in violation of any provisions of this
   act, shall be unenforceable within this Commonwealth as a matter of public policy.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Restrictions for Associations with Russia and Belarus Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2041. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Restrictions for Associations with Russia and Belarus Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2041. Short title

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2103. Rights of artists (2023)
content:
An artist shall retain at all times the right to claim authorship or, on the basis
   of a violation of section 4,1disclaim authorship of any work of fine art of which the artist is the creator.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Restrictions for Associations with Russia and Belarus Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2046. Critical materials and critical minerals
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Restrictions for Associations with Russia and Belarus Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2046. Critical materials and critical minerals
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2046. Critical materials and critical minerals (2023)
content:
The Treasury Department shall develop a list of critical materials and critical minerals
   as identified as critical by the United States Department of the Interior under Executive
   Order 13817.  A person who provides, obtains or supplies a mineral identified as critical minerals
   or materials to the Federal Government or United States domiciled business shall,
   upon notification to the Treasury Department, be removed from the list and exempted
   from any restrictions imposed by this act.  The list shall be reviewed annually and updated by the Treasury Department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 30. General Provisions›Restrictions for Associations with Russia and Belarus Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2045. Notice and challenge
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Restrictions for Associations with Russia and Belarus Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2045. Notice and challenge

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 30. General Provisions › Restrictions for Associations with Russia and Belarus Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2048. Construction

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2101. Short title

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2102. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2102. Definitions (2023)
content:
The following words and phrases when used in this act shall have the meanings given
   to them in this section unless the context clearly indicates otherwise:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2104. Mutilation, alteration or destruction of a work
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2104. Mutilation, alteration or destruction of a work
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2104. Mutilation, alteration or destruction of a work (2023)
content:
(a) Intentional acts.--No person, except an artist who owns and possesses a work of fine art which the artist
      has created, shall intentionally commit, or authorize the intentional commission of,
      any physical defacement, mutilation, alteration or destruction of a work of fine art.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2109. Period of limitation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2109. Period of limitation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2109. Period of limitation (2023)
content:
No action may be maintained to enforce any right under this act unless brought within
   three years of the violation complained of or one year after the discovery of the
   violation, whichever is later.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2110. Application of act
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2110. Application of act
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2110. Application of act (2023)
content:
(a) Location.--This act shall apply only to works of fine art displayed in a place within this Commonwealth
      accessible to the public.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 32. Artworks Consignment Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2122. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 32. Artworks Consignment Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2122. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2122. Definitions (2023)
content:
The following words and phrases when used in this act shall have the meanings given

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2108. Removal from building; waiver
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2108. Removal from building; waiver
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2108. Removal from building; waiver (2023)
content:
(a) Alteration unavoidable.--If a work of fine art cannot be removed from a building without substantial physical
      defacement, mutilation, alteration or destruction of such fine art, the rights and
      duties created under this act, unless expressly reserved by an instrument, in writing,
      signed by the owner of the building, shall be deemed waived.  Such instrument shall be binding on subsequent owners of the building.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2105. Remedies
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2105. Remedies
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2105. Remedies (2023)
content:
To effectuate the rights created by this act, the artist may commence an action to
   recover or obtain any of the following:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 32. Artworks Consignment Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2121. Short title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 32. Artworks Consignment Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2121. Short title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 73 P.S. § 2121. Short title (2023)
content: This act shall be known and may be cited as the Artworks Consignment Act.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce›Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act›PA ST 73 P.S. § 2111. Effective date
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 73 P.S. Trade and Commerce › Chapter 31. Fine Arts Preservation Act › PA ST 73 P.S. § 2111. Effective date
