content:
(a) Technician immunity.--A child passenger safety technician or sponsoring organization shall not be civilly
      liable for an act or omission that occurs solely in the inspection, installation or
      adjustment of a child passenger restraint system or child booster seat in a motor
      vehicle or in the giving of advice or assistance regarding the installation or adjustment
      of a child passenger restraint system or child booster seat in a motor vehicle if:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter C. Vehicles for Transportation of School Children›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4553. General requirements for other vehicles transporting school children
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter C. Vehicles for Transportation of School Children › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4553. General requirements for other vehicles transporting school children
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4553. General requirements for other vehicles transporting school children (2023)
content: (a) Buses operated by urban mass transportation systems.--

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4523. Exhaust systems, mufflers and noise control
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4523. Exhaust systems, mufflers and noise control
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4523. Exhaust systems, mufflers and noise control (2023)
content:
(a) Compliance with established sound levels.--Every motor vehicle operated on a highway shall be constructed, equipped, maintained
      and operated so as not to exceed the sound level for the vehicle as prescribed in
      regulations promulgated by the department.  The test procedures and instrumentation to be utilized shall also be established
      by regulation.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4525. Tire equipment and traction surfaces
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4525. Tire equipment and traction surfaces
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4525. Tire equipment and traction surfaces (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--No vehicle shall be operated on the highway unless the vehicle is equipped with tires
      of a type, size and construction approved by the department for the vehicle and unless
      the tires are in a safe operating condition as determined in accordance with regulations
      of the department, except that commercial implements of husbandry may be equipped
      with tires marked for nonhighway use.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4536. Bumpers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4536. Bumpers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4536. Bumpers (2023)
content:
No person shall operate any vehicle upon a highway without bumpers of a type specified
   by regulations of the department in both the front and rear unless the vehicle was
   originally designed and manufactured to be used without bumpers.  This section shall not apply to any special mobile equipment, commercial implement
   of husbandry or implement of husbandry that is not so equipped by the original manufacturer.  The driver of a commercial implement of husbandry equipped with vehicular hazard
   signal lamps shall use the signals when the vehicle is traveling below the speed limit
   on any highway if the vehicle is not equipped with a rear bumper.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4526. Safety glass
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4526. Safety glass
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4526. Safety glass (2023)
content:
(a) Safety glass required.--It is unlawful to sell or to operate on any highway in this Commonwealth any vehicle
      manufactured or assembled after January 1, 1934, and registered in this Commonwealth
      unless the vehicle is equipped with safety glass or similar material, which is in
      compliance with regulations promulgated by the department, wherever transparent or
      translucent material is used in the vehicle in doors, windows, windshields and wings.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter C. Vehicles for Transportation of School Children›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4552. General requirements for school buses
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter C. Vehicles for Transportation of School Children › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4552. General requirements for school buses
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4552. General requirements for school buses (2023)
content:
(a) Color and identification.--Every school bus shall be of a uniform color scheme and labeled “School Bus” on both
      front and rear as provided by regulation.  Exterior labels and markings other than those specifically required or permitted
      by law or regulation shall be prohibited. This subsection shall not be construed to prohibit the affixation of exterior labels
      or stickers of a temporary nature which have been approved by the school district
      as having educational value and which do not obscure the “School Bus” labels.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter D. Equipment of Authorized and Emergency Vehicles›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4572.1. Flashing or revolving lights on tow trucks
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter D. Equipment of Authorized and Emergency Vehicles › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4572.1. Flashing or revolving lights on tow trucks
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4572.1. Flashing or revolving lights on tow trucks (2023)
content: (a) Colored lights.--

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter D. Equipment of Authorized and Emergency Vehicles›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4572. Visual signals on authorized vehicles
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter D. Equipment of Authorized and Emergency Vehicles › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4572. Visual signals on authorized vehicles
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4572. Visual signals on authorized vehicles (2023)
content:
(a) Flashing or revolving blue lights.--Ambulance personnel, volunteer firefighters, certified volunteer search and rescue
      organization members and owners and handlers of dogs used in tracking humans may each
      equip one motor vehicle with no more than two flashing or revolving blue lights.  The following shall apply:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4529. Slow moving vehicle emblem
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4529. Slow moving vehicle emblem
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4529. Slow moving vehicle emblem (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--All implements of husbandry, commercial implements of husbandry and special mobile
      equipment designed to operate at 25 miles per hour or less and all animal-drawn vehicles
      shall, when traveling on a highway, display on the rear of the vehicle a reflective
      slow moving vehicle emblem as specified in regulations of the department.  The use of the slow moving vehicle emblem shall be in addition to any other lighting
      devices or equipment required by this title.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4527. Image display device
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4527. Image display device
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4527. Image display device (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--No motor vehicle shall be operated on a highway with an image display device where
      a broadcast television image, a live stream video image from the Internet, satellite
      or any other source or a prerecorded video image is visible to the driver while the
      vehicle is in motion.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4531. Emission control systems
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4531. Emission control systems
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4531. Emission control systems (2023)
content:
(a) Compliance with established maximum levels.--No vehicle manufactured in compliance with the requirements of the Clean Air Act (77
      Stat. 392,42 U.S.C. § 1857), or any amendments or supplements thereto, shall have emissions exceeding the maximum
      permissible levels prescribed by law.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4530. Portable emergency warning devices
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4530. Portable emergency warning devices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4530. Portable emergency warning devices (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Every truck, other than a truck registered as either a Class I or Class II having
      a gross weight of 7,000 pounds or less, truck tractor and bus and any motor vehicle
      towing a trailer shall carry at least three portable emergency warning devices of
      a type specified by regulations promulgated by the department.  The regulations shall be consistent with Motor Carrier Safety Regulations, Department
      of Transportation, Federal Highway Administration, Bureau of Motor Carrier Safety,
      section 393.95.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4528. Fire extinguishers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4528. Fire extinguishers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4528. Fire extinguishers (2023)
content:
Every vehicle towing a house trailer, every motor home and every motor vehicle with
   a mounted truck-camper shall be equipped with at least one fire extinguisher of a
   type and size approved by the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter D. Equipment of Authorized and Emergency Vehicles›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4573. Identification of certain vehicles
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter D. Equipment of Authorized and Emergency Vehicles › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4573. Identification of certain vehicles
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4573. Identification of certain vehicles (2023)
content:
(a) Commercial tow trucks.--Any truck which is used commercially to tow other motor vehicles shall have the name
      of the business, or person, operating the truck displayed on signs on both sides of
      the truck.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4524. Windshield obstructions and wipers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4524. Windshield obstructions and wipers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4524. Windshield obstructions and wipers (2023)
content:
(a) Obstruction on front windshield.--No person shall drive any motor vehicle with any sign, poster or other nontransparent
      material upon the front windshield which materially obstructs, obscures or impairs
      the driver's clear view of the highway or any intersecting highway except an inspection
      certificate, sticker identification sign on a mass transit vehicle or other officially
      required sticker and no person shall drive any motor vehicle with any ice or snow
      on the front windshield which materially obstructs, obscures or impairs the driver's
      clear view of the highway or any intersecting highway.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter D. Equipment of Authorized and Emergency Vehicles›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4572.2. Solid waste collection vehicles

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4572.2. Solid waste collection vehicles (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Upon approaching and passing a stationary solid waste collection vehicle that is giving
      a visual signal by means of a bright yellow strobe light as required under subsection
      (b), the driver of an approaching vehicle shall proceed as follows:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4534. Rearview mirrors
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4534. Rearview mirrors
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4534. Rearview mirrors (2023)
content:
No person shall operate a motor vehicle or combination on a highway unless the vehicle
   or combination is equipped with at least one mirror, or similar device, which provides
   the driver an unobstructed view of the highway to the rear of the vehicle or combination.  This section shall not apply to any special mobile equipment, commercial implement
   of husbandry or implement of husbandry that is not so equipped by the original manufacturer.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter E. Occupant Protection›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4583. Hospital information program
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter E. Occupant Protection › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4583. Hospital information program
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4583. Hospital information program (2023)
content:
(a) Availability of restraint devices.--The hospital, in conjunction with the attending physician, shall provide the parents
      of any newborn child with any information regarding the availability of loaner or
      rental programs for child restraint devices that may be available in the community
      where the child is born.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4532. Smoke control for diesel-powered motor vehicles
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4532. Smoke control for diesel-powered motor vehicles
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4532. Smoke control for diesel-powered motor vehicles (2023)
content:
(a) Standards and inspection.--The department shall promulgate regulations for the control of smoke from diesel-powered
      motor vehicles prescribing standards, inspection procedures and inspection equipment.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4537. Device used to carry pedalcycles
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4537. Device used to carry pedalcycles
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4537. Device used to carry pedalcycles (2023)
content:
Notwithstanding any other provision of this title to the contrary, a bus used for
   public transportation shall be permitted to operate with a device used to carry pedalcycles
   mounted on the front of the bus if the device, including the pedalcycles, does not
   extend more than 36 inches.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter E. Occupant Protection›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4585. Use of information or evidence of violation of subchapter
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter E. Occupant Protection › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4585. Use of information or evidence of violation of subchapter
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4585. Use of information or evidence of violation of subchapter (2023)
content:
The requirements of this subchapter or evidence of a violation of this subchapter
   may not be used by an insurer for any purpose.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment›Subchapter E. Occupant Protection›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4582. Child Passenger Restraint Fund
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Chapter 45. Other Required Equipment › Subchapter E. Occupant Protection › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4582. Child Passenger Restraint Fund
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4582. Child Passenger Restraint Fund (2023)
content:
A Child Passenger Restraint Fund is established in the General Fund as a special restricted
   receipts account hereby earmarked for and appropriated to the department.  This fund shall consist of all fines deposited pursuant to section 4581(b) (relating
   to restraint systems), all Federal funds granted for said use and any moneys donated
   into the fund.  All such funds shall be used solely for the purpose of purchasing Federally approved
   child restraint seats or appropriately fitting child booster seats and making such
   seats available to qualified loaner programs within the Commonwealth.  A qualified loaner program shall be one determined by the department to loan Federally
   approved child restraint seats or appropriately fitting child booster seats to parents
   or legal guardians of children under eight years of age who, due to financial or economic
   hardship, are unable to comply with the provisions of this subchapter.  The department shall adopt such regulations as are necessary to effectuate the purpose
   of this section.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics›Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4535. Audible warning devices
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part IV. Vehicle Characteristics › Subchapter B. Safety and Anti-Pollution Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4535. Audible warning devices
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 4535. Audible warning devices (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Every motor vehicle operated on a highway shall be equipped with a horn or other audible
      warning device of a type approved in regulations of the department.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part V. Administration and Enforcement›Chapter 61. Powers of Department and Local Authorities›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 6109. Specific powers of department and local authorities
