title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.8. Perfection of security interest in a snowmobile or ATV
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.8. Perfection of security interest in a snowmobile or ATV (2023)
content:
(a) Applicability of section.--Except as otherwise provided in13 Pa.C.S. §§ 9311(d)(relating to perfection of security interests in property subject to certain statutes,
      regulations and treaties), 9315(c) and (d) (relating to secured party's rights on
      disposition of collateral and in proceeds) and 9316(d) and (e) (relating to effect
      of change in governing law), this section provides the exclusive method of perfecting
      a security interest in a snowmobile or ATV for which a certificate of title is required
      under this subchapter.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.2. Limited registration of snowmobile or ATV
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.2. Limited registration of snowmobile or ATV
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.2. Limited registration of snowmobile or ATV (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--It is unlawful for a person to operate or for an owner to permit another person to
      operate a snowmobile or ATV identified in section 7711.1(f)(3) (relating to registration
      of snowmobile or ATV) unless:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711. Registration of dealers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711. Registration of dealers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711. Registration of dealers (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A person who is in the business of selling snowmobiles or ATV's in this Commonwealth
      shall register with the department as a dealer.  A person who is in the business of selling snowmobiles or ATV's outside this Commonwealth
      may register with the department as a dealer.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7715.2. Fees
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7715.2. Fees
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7715.2. Fees (2023)
content: (a) Fees.--Except as provided in subsection (b), the department shall collect the following fees:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.1. Certificate of title for snowmobile or ATV
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.1. Certificate of title for snowmobile or ATV
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.1. Certificate of title for snowmobile or ATV (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided in subsection (b), an owner of a snowmobile or ATV which
      is in this Commonwealth and for which no certificate of title has been issued shall
      apply to the department for a certificate of title.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.2. Transfer to or from dealer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.2. Transfer to or from dealer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.2. Transfer to or from dealer (2023)
content:
(a) Transfer to dealer.--If a dealer acquires a snowmobile or ATV for the purpose of resale, a certificate
      of title need not be applied for as provided for in section 7712.1 (relating to certificate
      of title for snowmobile or ATV), but the dealer shall, within seven days from the
      date of acquisition, forward to the department, upon a form prescribed and furnished
      by the department, notification of the acquisition of the snowmobile or ATV.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.3. Transfer of snowmobile or ATV by operation of law
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.3. Transfer of snowmobile or ATV by operation of law
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.3. Transfer of snowmobile or ATV by operation of law (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If the interest of an owner in a snowmobile or ATV passes to another other than by
      voluntary transfer, the transferee shall, except as otherwise provided, promptly mail
      or deliver to the department the last certificate of title, if available, and shall
      apply for a new certificate of title on a form prescribed and furnished by the department.  The application shall be accompanied by such instruments or documents of authority,
      or certified copies thereof, as may be sufficient or required by law to evidence or
      effect a transfer of title or interest in or to chattels in such case.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.6. Suspension and cancellation of certificate of title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.6. Suspension and cancellation of certificate of title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.6. Suspension and cancellation of certificate of title (2023)
content:
(a) Return of new snowmobile or ATV.--The department may cancel the certificate of title issued for a new snowmobile or
      ATV if it is shown by satisfactory evidence that the snowmobile or ATV has been returned
      to the dealer from whom obtained.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.4. Correction of certificate of title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.4. Correction of certificate of title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.4. Correction of certificate of title (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--When a certificate of title has been issued in error to a person not entitled to it
      or contains incorrect information, or information has been omitted from the certificate,
      the department shall notify in writing the person to whom the certificate has been
      issued or delivered, and such person shall return the certificate within 48 hours,
      together with any other information necessary for the adjustment of the department
      records, and upon receipt of the certificate, the department shall cancel the certificate
      and issue a corrected certificate.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.9. Satisfaction of security interest
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.9. Satisfaction of security interest
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.9. Satisfaction of security interest (2023)
content:
(a) Satisfaction of secured obligation.--Unless otherwise agreed by the owner, within 15 days of the satisfaction of the obligation
      secured by a security interest in a snowmobile or ATV, the secured party shall mail
      or deliver the certificate of title to the owner or to the department with a statement
      of satisfaction signed by the secured party.  Upon receipt of the certificate of title and statement of satisfaction, the department
      shall issue a corrected certificate of title without an indorsement of such secured
      party's security interest and mail the same to the holder of the first remaining security
      interest or, if there is no remaining security interest, the owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.12. Assignment by secured party of security interest
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.12. Assignment by secured party of security interest
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.12. Assignment by secured party of security interest (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A secured party may assign, absolutely or otherwise, his security interest in a snowmobile
      or ATV to a person other than the owner without affecting the interest of the owner
      or the validity or perfection of the security interest.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.10. Release of security interest
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.10. Release of security interest
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.10. Release of security interest (2023)
content:
A secured party that releases a security interest in a snowmobile or ATV shall mail
   or deliver the certificate of title to the owner with a statement of release signed
   by the secured party, or the secured party may apply to the department for a corrected
   certificate of title to be issued in the name of the owner.  Upon receipt of the certificate of title and statement of release, the department
   shall issue a corrected certificate of title without an indorsement of such secured
   party and mail the same to the holder of the first remaining security interest or,
   if there is no remaining secured party, the owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.7. Application for certificate of title by agent
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.7. Application for certificate of title by agent
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.7. Application for certificate of title by agent (2023)
content:
(a) Authorization to apply.--No person may apply for a certificate of title on behalf of another person unless
      authorization to do so is in effect and is verified by oath or affirmation of the
      other person, made, except as between lessors and fleet owners as lessees, not more
      than 15 days before the application is received by the department. A lessor may authorize a fleet owner to apply for a certificate of title for a leased
      snowmobile or ATV for a period of up to one year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.5. Issuance of new certificate following transfer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.5. Issuance of new certificate following transfer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.5. Issuance of new certificate following transfer (2023)
content:
(a) Voluntary transfer.--The department, upon receipt of a properly assigned certificate of title with an application
      for a new certificate of title, the required fee and any other required documents
      and articles, shall issue a new certificate of title in the name of the transferee
      as owner and mail it to the first secured party named in the certificate or, if none,
      to the owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7724. Operation on private or State property
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7724. Operation on private or State property
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7724. Operation on private or State property (2023)
content: (a) Private real property.--

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7715.1. Snowmobile or ATV purchased from dealer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7715.1. Snowmobile or ATV purchased from dealer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7715.1. Snowmobile or ATV purchased from dealer (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If a snowmobile or ATV is purchased from a dealer, the dealer shall mail or deliver
      to the department an application for a registration certificate or limited registration
      certificate, an application for certificate of title, any other required forms and
      the required fees within 15 days of the date of purchase.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.13. Exemptions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.13. Exemptions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.13. Exemptions (2023)
content:
The provisions of this subchapter relating to procedures for perfecting, assigning
   and satisfying security interests do not apply to:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.11. Effectiveness of security interests
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.11. Effectiveness of security interests
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.11. Effectiveness of security interests (2023)
content:
A security interest perfected in accordance with this subchapter is perfected until
   the secured party provides written evidence of satisfaction in accordance with section
   7712.9 (relating to satisfaction of security interest) or release in accordance with
   section 7712.10 (relating to release of security interest) and the indorsement of
   the security interest is removed by the department pursuant to section 7712.9 or 7712.10.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7718. Vintage snowmobile permits
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7718. Vintage snowmobile permits
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7718. Vintage snowmobile permits (2023)
content:
(a) Issuance of permits.--Upon receipt of an application upon a form prescribed and furnished by the department
      which shall contain information required by the department and which shall be accompanied
      by the required fee and any other information the department shall require, the department
      shall issue to an owner of a vintage snowmobile a vintage snowmobile permit containing
      a permit number.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7717. Snowmobile and ATV Advisory Committee
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7717. Snowmobile and ATV Advisory Committee
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7717. Snowmobile and ATV Advisory Committee (2023)
content:
(a) Establishment.--There is hereby established under the jurisdiction of the department a board known
      as the Snowmobile and ATV Advisory Committee.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7721. Operation on streets and highways
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7721. Operation on streets and highways
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7721. Operation on streets and highways (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, it is unlawful to operate a snowmobile
      or an ATV on any street or highway which is not designated and posted as a snowmobile
      or an ATV road by the governmental agency having jurisdiction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7729. Liability of owner for negligence
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7729. Liability of owner for negligence
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7729. Liability of owner for negligence (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Negligence in the use or operation of a snowmobile or an ATV is attributable to the
      owner.  Every owner of a snowmobile or an ATV used or operated in this Commonwealth shall
      be liable and responsible for death or injury to person or damage to property resulting
      from negligence in the use or operation of such snowmobile or ATV by any person using
      or operating the snowmobile or ATV with the permission, express or implied, of such
      owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7716. Records

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7716. Records (2023)
content:
The department shall maintain a record, which shall be made available to all enforcement
   agencies, of:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7702. Definitions
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7702. Definitions
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7702. Definitions (2023)
content:
The following words and phrases when used in this chapter shall have, unless the context
   clearly indicates otherwise, the meanings given to them in this section:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7722. Designation of snowmobile and ATV roads
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7722. Designation of snowmobile and ATV roads
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7722. Designation of snowmobile and ATV roads (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The Department of Transportation on State-designated highways and local authorities
      on any highway, road or street within its jurisdiction may designate any highway,
      road or street within its jurisdiction as a snowmobile road, an ATV road, or both,
      and may, in its discretion, determine whether such road shall be closed to vehicular
      traffic or whether snowmobiles and ATV's may share this designated road with vehicular
      traffic.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7701. Short title of chapter
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7701. Short title of chapter
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7701. Short title of chapter (2023)
content:
This chapter shall be known and may be cited as the Snowmobile and All-Terrain Vehicle
   Law.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7703. Applicability of chapter
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7703. Applicability of chapter
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7703. Applicability of chapter (2023)
content:
This chapter does not apply to law enforcement officers while engaged in the performance
   of their official duties.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7704. Rules and regulations
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7704. Rules and regulations
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7704. Rules and regulations (2023)
content:
The department may promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry
   out the provisions of this chapter.

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7726. Operation in safe manner (2023)
content: (a) General rule.--No person shall operate a snowmobile or an ATV in any of the following ways:

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7727. Additional limitations on operation (2023)
content: Except as otherwise permitted under Title 34 (relating to game), no person shall:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7723. Special snowmobile and ATV events
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7723. Special snowmobile and ATV events
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7723. Special snowmobile and ATV events (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Snowmobiles and ATV's may be operated on highways and streets for special snowmobile
      and ATV events of limited duration which are conducted according to a prearranged
      schedule under permit from the governmental agency having jurisdiction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7725. Operation by persons under age sixteen
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7725. Operation by persons under age sixteen
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7725. Operation by persons under age sixteen (2023)
content:
(a) Crossing street or highway.--No person under 16 years of age shall drive a snowmobile or an ATV across any highway
      or connecting street thereto unless he is under the direct supervision of a person
      18 years of age or older and unless he holds a valid and appropriate safety certificate
      from the Commonwealth or a valid and approved certificate issued under the authority
      of another state or Province of Canada.  The department shall determine what certificates will be approved.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7706. Restricted accounts
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7706. Restricted accounts
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7706. Restricted accounts (2023)
content: (a) Deposit and use of moneys.--

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter A. General Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7705. Records and reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter A. General Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7705. Records and reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7705. Records and reports (2023)
content:
The provisions of Subchapter B1of Chapter 63 (relating to records of traffic cases) relating to records and reports
   shall be applicable to proceedings under this chapter.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711. Registration of dealers
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711. Registration of dealers
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711. Registration of dealers (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--A person who is in the business of selling snowmobiles or ATV's in this Commonwealth
      shall register with the department as a dealer.  A person who is in the business of selling snowmobiles or ATV's outside this Commonwealth
      may register with the department as a dealer.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.1. Registration of snowmobile or ATV
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.1. Registration of snowmobile or ATV
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.1. Registration of snowmobile or ATV (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided in subsection (f), it is unlawful for a person to operate
      or for an owner to permit another person to operate a snowmobile or an ATV unless:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter E. Miscellaneous Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7751. Enforcement personnel and procedures
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter E. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7751. Enforcement personnel and procedures
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7751. Enforcement personnel and procedures (2023)
content:
(a) Duty of enforcement.--Every law enforcement officer in this Commonwealth and designated officers and employees
      of the department shall enforce the provisions of this chapter.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter D. Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7741. Head lamps and tail lamps
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter D. Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7741. Head lamps and tail lamps
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7741. Head lamps and tail lamps (2023)
content:
(a) Time of operation.--Every snowmobile or ATV operated during hours of darkness shall display a lighted
      head lamp and tail lamp.  The lights shall be in operation during the period of from one-half hour after sunset
      to one-half hour before sunrise and at any time when, due to insufficient light or
      unfavorable atmospheric conditions caused by fog or otherwise, other persons, vehicles
      and other objects are not clearly discernible for a distance of 500 feet ahead.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter D. Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7742. Brakes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter D. Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7742. Brakes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7742. Brakes (2023)
content:
(a) Snowmobiles.--It is unlawful to operate a snowmobile which is not equipped with at least one brake
      of a design approved by the department operated either by hand or by foot, capable
      of bringing the snowmobile to a stop, under normal conditions, within 40 feet when
      traveling at a speed of 20 miles per hour with a 150 pound driver and on hard packed
      snow, or locking its traction belt or belts.  The design shall permit simple and easy adjustment to compensate for wear.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.2. Limited registration of snowmobile or ATV
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.2. Limited registration of snowmobile or ATV
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7711.2. Limited registration of snowmobile or ATV (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--It is unlawful for a person to operate or for an owner to permit another person to
      operate a snowmobile or ATV identified in section 7711.1(f)(3) (relating to registration
      of snowmobile or ATV) unless:

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7730. Liability insurance
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7730. Liability insurance
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7730. Liability insurance (2023)
content:
(a) Requirement.--A snowmobile or ATV for which registration is required under this chapter shall have
      liability insurance coverage for the snowmobile or ATV issued by an insurance carrier
      authorized to do business in this Commonwealth.  This subsection does not apply to limited registrations.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.4. Correction of certificate of title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.4. Correction of certificate of title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.4. Correction of certificate of title (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--When a certificate of title has been issued in error to a person not entitled to it
      or contains incorrect information, or information has been omitted from the certificate,
      the department shall notify in writing the person to whom the certificate has been
      issued or delivered, and such person shall return the certificate within 48 hours,
      together with any other information necessary for the adjustment of the department
      records, and upon receipt of the certificate, the department shall cancel the certificate
      and issue a corrected certificate.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.3. Transfer of snowmobile or ATV by operation of law
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.3. Transfer of snowmobile or ATV by operation of law
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.3. Transfer of snowmobile or ATV by operation of law (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If the interest of an owner in a snowmobile or ATV passes to another other than by
      voluntary transfer, the transferee shall, except as otherwise provided, promptly mail
      or deliver to the department the last certificate of title, if available, and shall
      apply for a new certificate of title on a form prescribed and furnished by the department.  The application shall be accompanied by such instruments or documents of authority,
      or certified copies thereof, as may be sufficient or required by law to evidence or
      effect a transfer of title or interest in or to chattels in such case.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.1. Certificate of title for snowmobile or ATV
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.1. Certificate of title for snowmobile or ATV
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.1. Certificate of title for snowmobile or ATV (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided in subsection (b), an owner of a snowmobile or ATV which
      is in this Commonwealth and for which no certificate of title has been issued shall
      apply to the department for a certificate of title.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7728. Accidents and accident reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7728. Accidents and accident reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7728. Accidents and accident reports (2023)
content:
(a) Duty to stop and provide information.--Whenever any snowmobile or ATV is involved in an accident resulting in loss of life,
      personal injury or damage to property and the operator thereof has knowledge of such
      accident, he shall stop and give his name and address, the name and address of the
      owner thereof and the registration number of the snowmobile or ATV to the injured
      person or the person sustaining the damage or to a police officer.  In case no police officer nor the person sustaining the damage is present at the
      place where the damage occurred, then the operator shall immediately report, as soon
      as he is physically able, the accident to the nearest law enforcement agency.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter E. Miscellaneous Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7753. Actions for collection of penalties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter E. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7753. Actions for collection of penalties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7753. Actions for collection of penalties (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--An action to recover any penalty imposed under the provisions of this chapter may
      be brought in any court of competent jurisdiction in this Commonwealth on order of
      the department and in the name of the Commonwealth.  In any such action all penalties incurred up to the time of commencing the action
      may be sued for and recovered therein and the commencement of an action to recover
      any such penalty shall not be, or be held to be, a waiver of the right to recover
      any other penalty.  In case of recovery of any amount in an action brought to recover any such penalty
      the Commonwealth shall be entitled to recover full costs and at the rates provided
      for civil actions.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.2. Transfer to or from dealer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.2. Transfer to or from dealer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.2. Transfer to or from dealer (2023)
content:
(a) Transfer to dealer.--If a dealer acquires a snowmobile or ATV for the purpose of resale, a certificate
      of title need not be applied for as provided for in section 7712.1 (relating to certificate
      of title for snowmobile or ATV), but the dealer shall, within seven days from the
      date of acquisition, forward to the department, upon a form prescribed and furnished
      by the department, notification of the acquisition of the snowmobile or ATV.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.6. Suspension and cancellation of certificate of title
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.6. Suspension and cancellation of certificate of title
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.6. Suspension and cancellation of certificate of title (2023)
content:
(a) Return of new snowmobile or ATV.--The department may cancel the certificate of title issued for a new snowmobile or
      ATV if it is shown by satisfactory evidence that the snowmobile or ATV has been returned
      to the dealer from whom obtained.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.9. Satisfaction of security interest
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.9. Satisfaction of security interest
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.9. Satisfaction of security interest (2023)
content:
(a) Satisfaction of secured obligation.--Unless otherwise agreed by the owner, within 15 days of the satisfaction of the obligation
      secured by a security interest in a snowmobile or ATV, the secured party shall mail
      or deliver the certificate of title to the owner or to the department with a statement
      of satisfaction signed by the secured party.  Upon receipt of the certificate of title and statement of satisfaction, the department
      shall issue a corrected certificate of title without an indorsement of such secured
      party's security interest and mail the same to the holder of the first remaining security
      interest or, if there is no remaining security interest, the owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.5. Issuance of new certificate following transfer
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.5. Issuance of new certificate following transfer
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.5. Issuance of new certificate following transfer (2023)
content:
(a) Voluntary transfer.--The department, upon receipt of a properly assigned certificate of title with an application
      for a new certificate of title, the required fee and any other required documents
      and articles, shall issue a new certificate of title in the name of the transferee
      as owner and mail it to the first secured party named in the certificate or, if none,
      to the owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.8. Perfection of security interest in a snowmobile or ATV
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.8. Perfection of security interest in a snowmobile or ATV
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.8. Perfection of security interest in a snowmobile or ATV (2023)
content:
(a) Applicability of section.--Except as otherwise provided in13 Pa.C.S. §§ 9311(d)(relating to perfection of security interests in property subject to certain statutes,
      regulations and treaties), 9315(c) and (d) (relating to secured party's rights on
      disposition of collateral and in proceeds) and 9316(d) and (e) (relating to effect
      of change in governing law), this section provides the exclusive method of perfecting
      a security interest in a snowmobile or ATV for which a certificate of title is required
      under this subchapter.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.11. Effectiveness of security interests
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.11. Effectiveness of security interests
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.11. Effectiveness of security interests (2023)
content:
A security interest perfected in accordance with this subchapter is perfected until
   the secured party provides written evidence of satisfaction in accordance with section
   7712.9 (relating to satisfaction of security interest) or release in accordance with
   section 7712.10 (relating to release of security interest) and the indorsement of
   the security interest is removed by the department pursuant to section 7712.9 or 7712.10.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.10. Release of security interest
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.10. Release of security interest
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.10. Release of security interest (2023)
content:
A secured party that releases a security interest in a snowmobile or ATV shall mail
   or deliver the certificate of title to the owner with a statement of release signed
   by the secured party, or the secured party may apply to the department for a corrected
   certificate of title to be issued in the name of the owner.  Upon receipt of the certificate of title and statement of release, the department
   shall issue a corrected certificate of title without an indorsement of such secured
   party and mail the same to the holder of the first remaining security interest or,
   if there is no remaining secured party, the owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles›Subchapter D. Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7743. Mufflers and sound control
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77. Snowmobiles and All-Terrain Vehicles › Subchapter D. Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7743. Mufflers and sound control
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7743. Mufflers and sound control (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--It is unlawful to operate a snowmobile or an ATV which is not equipped at all times
      with a muffler in good working order which blends the exhaust sound into the overall
      snowmobile or ATV sound and is in constant operation to prevent excessive or unusual
      sound.  The exhaust system shall not emit or produce a sharp popping or crackling sound.  The sound intensity produced by a snowmobile shall not exceed 82dbA when measured
      in accordance with SAE Recommended Practice J 192 Exterior Sound Level for Snowmobiles,
      as amended.  The department may by regulation adopt more stringent sound requirements for snowmobiles.  The department shall by regulation adopt sound requirements for in-use operation
      of ATV's using measurement procedures in accordance with SAE Recommended Practice
      J 1287 July 1998, Measurement of Exhaust Level of Stationary Motorcycles.  The sound level intensity produced by an ATV manufactured before January 1, 1998,
      shall not exceed 99dbA, or decibels, when measured at 20 inches.  The sound level intensity produced by an ATV manufactured on or after January 1,
      1998, shall not exceed 96dbA, or decibels, when measured at 20 inches.

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7715.1. Snowmobile or ATV purchased from dealer (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--If a snowmobile or ATV is purchased from a dealer, the dealer shall mail or deliver
      to the department an application for a registration certificate or limited registration
      certificate, an application for certificate of title, any other required forms and
      the required fees within 15 days of the date of purchase.

content:
(a) General rule.--A secured party may assign, absolutely or otherwise, his security interest in a snowmobile
      or ATV to a person other than the owner without affecting the interest of the owner
      or the validity or perfection of the security interest.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Certificates of Title, Registration and Permits›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.7. Application for certificate of title by agent

citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7712.7. Application for certificate of title by agent (2023)
content:
(a) Authorization to apply.--No person may apply for a certificate of title on behalf of another person unless
      authorization to do so is in effect and is verified by oath or affirmation of the
      other person, made, except as between lessors and fleet owners as lessees, not more
      than 15 days before the application is received by the department. A lessor may authorize a fleet owner to apply for a certificate of title for a leased
      snowmobile or ATV for a period of up to one year.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7721. Operation on streets and highways
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7721. Operation on streets and highways (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as otherwise provided in this chapter, it is unlawful to operate a snowmobile
      or an ATV on any street or highway which is not designated and posted as a snowmobile
      or an ATV road by the governmental agency having jurisdiction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7722. Designation of snowmobile and ATV roads
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7722. Designation of snowmobile and ATV roads
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7722. Designation of snowmobile and ATV roads (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The Department of Transportation on State-designated highways and local authorities
      on any highway, road or street within its jurisdiction may designate any highway,
      road or street within its jurisdiction as a snowmobile road, an ATV road, or both,
      and may, in its discretion, determine whether such road shall be closed to vehicular
      traffic or whether snowmobiles and ATV's may share this designated road with vehicular
      traffic.

content:
(a) Issuance of permits.--Upon receipt of an application upon a form prescribed and furnished by the department
      which shall contain information required by the department and which shall be accompanied
      by the required fee and any other information the department shall require, the department
      shall issue to an owner of a vintage snowmobile a vintage snowmobile permit containing
      a permit number.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7723. Special snowmobile and ATV events

content:
(a) General rule.--Snowmobiles and ATV's may be operated on highways and streets for special snowmobile
      and ATV events of limited duration which are conducted according to a prearranged
      schedule under permit from the governmental agency having jurisdiction.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7725. Operation by persons under age sixteen
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7725. Operation by persons under age sixteen
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7725. Operation by persons under age sixteen (2023)
content:
(a) Crossing street or highway.--No person under 16 years of age shall drive a snowmobile or an ATV across any highway
      or connecting street thereto unless he is under the direct supervision of a person
      18 years of age or older and unless he holds a valid and appropriate safety certificate
      from the Commonwealth or a valid and approved certificate issued under the authority
      of another state or Province of Canada.  The department shall determine what certificates will be approved.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7729. Liability of owner for negligence
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7729. Liability of owner for negligence
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7729. Liability of owner for negligence (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Negligence in the use or operation of a snowmobile or an ATV is attributable to the
      owner.  Every owner of a snowmobile or an ATV used or operated in this Commonwealth shall
      be liable and responsible for death or injury to person or damage to property resulting
      from negligence in the use or operation of such snowmobile or ATV by any person using
      or operating the snowmobile or ATV with the permission, express or implied, of such
      owner.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7728. Accidents and accident reports
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter C. Operation › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7728. Accidents and accident reports
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7728. Accidents and accident reports (2023)
content:
(a) Duty to stop and provide information.--Whenever any snowmobile or ATV is involved in an accident resulting in loss of life,
      personal injury or damage to property and the operator thereof has knowledge of such
      accident, he shall stop and give his name and address, the name and address of the
      owner thereof and the registration number of the snowmobile or ATV to the injured
      person or the person sustaining the damage or to a police officer.  In case no police officer nor the person sustaining the damage is present at the
      place where the damage occurred, then the operator shall immediately report, as soon
      as he is physically able, the accident to the nearest law enforcement agency.

      as the Snowmobile and ATV Advisory Committee.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter D. Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7741. Head lamps and tail lamps
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7741. Head lamps and tail lamps (2023)
content:
(a) Time of operation.--Every snowmobile or ATV operated during hours of darkness shall display a lighted
      head lamp and tail lamp.  The lights shall be in operation during the period of from one-half hour after sunset
      to one-half hour before sunrise and at any time when, due to insufficient light or
      unfavorable atmospheric conditions caused by fog or otherwise, other persons, vehicles
      and other objects are not clearly discernible for a distance of 500 feet ahead.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter E. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7751. Enforcement personnel and procedures
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7751. Enforcement personnel and procedures (2023)
content:
(a) Duty of enforcement.--Every law enforcement officer in this Commonwealth and designated officers and employees
      of the department shall enforce the provisions of this chapter.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter E. Miscellaneous Provisions›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7753. Actions for collection of penalties
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter E. Miscellaneous Provisions › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7753. Actions for collection of penalties
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7753. Actions for collection of penalties (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--An action to recover any penalty imposed under the provisions of this chapter may
      be brought in any court of competent jurisdiction in this Commonwealth on order of
      the department and in the name of the Commonwealth.  In any such action all penalties incurred up to the time of commencing the action
      may be sued for and recovered therein and the commencement of an action to recover
      any such penalty shall not be, or be held to be, a waiver of the right to recover
      any other penalty.  In case of recovery of any amount in an action brought to recover any such penalty
      the Commonwealth shall be entitled to recover full costs and at the rates provided
      for civil actions.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter D. Equipment›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7742. Brakes
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter D. Equipment › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7742. Brakes
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7742. Brakes (2023)
content:
(a) Snowmobiles.--It is unlawful to operate a snowmobile which is not equipped with at least one brake
      of a design approved by the department operated either by hand or by foot, capable
      of bringing the snowmobile to a stop, under normal conditions, within 40 feet when
      traveling at a speed of 20 miles per hour with a 150 pound driver and on hard packed
      snow, or locking its traction belt or belts.  The design shall permit simple and easy adjustment to compensate for wear.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter C. Operation›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7730. Liability insurance

content:
(a) Requirement.--A snowmobile or ATV for which registration is required under this chapter shall have
      liability insurance coverage for the snowmobile or ATV issued by an insurance carrier
      authorized to do business in this Commonwealth.  This subsection does not apply to limited registrations.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77A. Operation of Golf Carts › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 77A02. Designation of golf cart crossings
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 77A02. Designation of golf cart crossings (2023)
content:

      the local authority's jurisdiction may designate a crossing within the jurisdiction
      as a golf cart crossing with official traffic-control devices for the crossings.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 78. Motor Carrier Safety›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7801. Short title of chapter

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 79. Motorcycles›Subchapter B. Motorcycle Safety Education›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7911. Motorcycle safety education program
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 79. Motorcycles › Subchapter B. Motorcycle Safety Education › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7911. Motorcycle safety education program
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7911. Motorcycle safety education program (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The department shall establish a motorcycle safety education program throughout this
      Commonwealth.  It shall approve and conduct an annual review of course material for authorized
      schools.  It shall certify all instructors and shall include a uniform curriculum for the
      course of instruction and training requirements for instructors.  The department shall be responsible for certifying schools to conduct approved motorcycle
      safety courses and shall adopt such necessary rules and regulations to govern the
      administration of motorcycle education within this Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Chapter 77A. Operation of Golf Carts›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 77A03. Operation by persons under 16 years of age
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77A. Operation of Golf Carts › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 77A03. Operation by persons under 16 years of age
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 77A03. Operation by persons under 16 years of age (2023)
content:
A person under 12 years of age may not operate a golf cart.  A person between 12 and 16 years of age may not drive a golf cart across any highway
   unless the person is under the direct supervision of a person 18 years of age or older.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles›Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions›Subchapter B. Motorcycle Safety Education›PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7911. Motorcycle safety education program
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Subchapter B. Motorcycle Safety Education › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7911. Motorcycle safety education program
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 7911. Motorcycle safety education program (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--The department shall establish a motorcycle safety education program throughout this
      Commonwealth.  It shall approve and conduct an annual review of course material for authorized
      schools.  It shall certify all instructors and shall include a uniform curriculum for the
      course of instruction and training requirements for instructors.  The department shall be responsible for certifying schools to conduct approved motorcycle
      safety courses and shall adopt such necessary rules and regulations to govern the
      administration of motorcycle education within this Commonwealth.

title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 75 Pa.C.S.A. Vehicles › Part VI. Miscellaneous Provisions › Chapter 77A. Operation of Golf Carts › PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 77A01. Operation on highways
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 75 Pa.C.S.A. § 77A01. Operation on highways (2023)
content:
(a) General rule.--Except as described under section 1302(3) or (14) (relating to vehicles exempt from
      registration) or otherwise provided under this chapter, it is unlawful to operate
      a golf cart on any highway.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.6. Long-term exposure
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.6. Long-term exposure
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.6. Long-term exposure (2023)
content:
The term “long-term exposure,” as used in this act, means exposure to noise exceeding
   the permissible daily exposure for at least three days each week for forty weeks of
   one year.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 22b. “Employe” includes auxiliary police of cities, boroughs, incorporated towns and townships
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 22b. “Employe” includes auxiliary police of cities, boroughs, incorporated towns and townships
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 22b. “Employe” includes auxiliary police of cities, boroughs, incorporated towns and townships (2023)
content:
In addition to those persons included within the definition of the word “employe”
   as defined in section 104 of the act of June 2, 1915 (P.L. 736), known as “The Pennsylvania
   Workmen's Compensation Act,” reenacted and amended June 21, 1939 (P.L. 520), and amended
   February 28, 1956 (P.L. 1120),1there shall be included all auxiliary police of the various cities, boroughs, incorporated
   towns and townships, who shall be “employes” of such cities, boroughs, incorporated
   towns and townships for all the purposes of the act, and shall be entitled to receive
   compensation in case of injuries received while actually engaged as policemen or while
   going to or returning from their place of duty or while participating in instruction
   or while answering any emergency call for any purpose or while performing any other
   duty authorized by the city, borough, incorporated town or township.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 26. Trade or business of local or other public authority
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 26. Trade or business of local or other public authority
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 26. Trade or business of local or other public authority (2023)
content:
The exercise and performance of the powers and duties of a local or other public authority
   shall, for the purposes of this act, be treated as the trade or business of the authority.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 21. “Employer” defined
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 21. “Employer” defined
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 21. “Employer” defined (2023)
content:
The term “employer,” as used in this act, is declared to be synonymous with master,
   and to include natural persons, partnerships, joint-stock companies, corporations
   for profit, corporations not for profit, municipal corporations, the Commonwealth,
   and all governmental agencies created by it.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 22d. “Employe” includes special school police; knowledge of other employment; self-employment; wages; minimum compensation
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 22d. “Employe” includes special school police; knowledge of other employment; self-employment; wages; minimum compensation
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 22d. “Employe” includes special school police; knowledge of other employment; self-employment; wages; minimum compensation (2023)
content:
In addition to those persons included within the definition of the word “employe”
   as defined in section 104, act of June 2, 1915 (P.L. 736), known as “The Pennsylvania
   Workmen's Compensation Act,” reenacted and amended June 21, 1939 (P.L. 520) and amended
   February 28, 1956 (P.L. 1120),1there shall be included all special school police in municipalities and townships,
   who shall be and are hereby declared to be “employes” of the appointing municipality
   or township for all the purposes of said act, and shall be entitled to receive compensation
   in case of injuries received while actually engaged as policemen or while participating
   in instruction or while answering any emergency call for any purpose or while performing
   any other duty authorized by the municipality or township.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.3. Construction design professional
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.3. Construction design professional
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.3. Construction design professional (2023)
content:
The term “construction design professional,” as used in this act, means a professional
   engineer or land surveyor licensed by the State Registration Board for Professional
   Engineers, Land Surveyors and Geologists under the act of May 23, 1945 (P.L. 913,
   No. 367), known as the “Engineer, Land Surveyor and Geologist Registration Law,”1a landscape architect who is licensed by the State Board of Landscape Architects
   under the act of January 24, 1966 (1965 P.L. 1527, No. 535), known as the “Landscape
   Architects' Registration Law,”2an architect who is licensed by the Architects Licensure Board under the act of December
   14, 1982 (P.L. 1227, No. 281), known as the “Architects Licensure Law,”3or any corporation or association, including professional corporations, organized
   or registered under the act of December 21, 1988 (P.L. 1444, No. 177), known as the
   “General Association Act of 1988,”4practicing engineering, architecture, landscape architecture or surveying in this
   Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 27. “Department” and “Board” defined
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 27. “Department” and “Board” defined
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 27. “Department” and “Board” defined (2023)
content: The term “Department,” when used in this act, shall mean the Department of Labor and Industry of this Commonwealth.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.2. Maximum weekly compensation payable
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.2. Maximum weekly compensation payable
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.2. Maximum weekly compensation payable (2023)
content:
The terms “the maximum weekly compensation payable” and “the maximum compensation
   payable per week,” as used in this act, mean sixty-six and two-thirds per centum of
   “the Statewide average weekly wage” as defined in section 105.1.1Effective July 1, 1975, the terms “the maximum weekly compensation payable” and
   “the maximum compensation payable per week” as used in this act for injuries or death
   after the effective date of this amendatory act shall mean the Statewide average weekly
   wage as defined in section 105.2

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 2. Damages by Action at Law›Employer's Liability›PA ST 77 P.S. § 52. Employers' liability to employe of employe or contractor permitted to enter upon premises
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 2. Damages by Action at Law › Employer's Liability › PA ST 77 P.S. § 52. Employers' liability to employe of employe or contractor permitted to enter upon premises
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 52. Employers' liability to employe of employe or contractor permitted to enter upon premises (2023)
content:
An employer who permits the entry upon premises occupied by him or under his control
   of a laborer or an assistant hired by an employe or contractor, for the performance
   upon such premises of a part of the employer's regular business entrusted to such
   employe or contractor, shall be liable to such laborer or assistant in the same manner
   and to the same extent as to his own employe.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Citation and Construction of Act›PA ST 77 P.S. § 1. Short title; application of act
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Citation and Construction of Act › PA ST 77 P.S. § 1. Short title; application of act
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 1. Short title; application of act (2023)
content:
That this act shall be called and cited as the Workers' Compensation Act, and shall
   apply to all injuries occurring within this Commonwealth, irrespective of the place
   where the contract of hiring was made, renewed, or extended, and extraterritorially
   as provided by section 305.2.1

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.5. Impairment Guides
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.5. Impairment Guides
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.5. Impairment Guides (2023)
content:
The term “Impairment Guides,” as used in this act, means the American Medical Association's Guides to the Evaluation

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 25. “Contractor” defined
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 25. “Contractor” defined
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 25. “Contractor” defined (2023)
content:
The term “contractor,” as used in article two, section two hundred and three,1and article three, section three hundred and two (b),2shall not include a contractor engaged in an independent business, other than that
   of supplying laborers or assistants, in which he serves persons other than the employer
   in whose service the injury occurs, but shall include a sub-contractor to whom a principal
   contractor has sublet any part of the work which such principal contractor has undertaken.

path: Pennsylvania Statutes›Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation›Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions›Definitions›PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.1. Statewide average weekly wage
title: PA Statutes › Pennsylvania Statutes › Title 77 P.S. Workers' Compensation › Chapter 1. Interpretation and Definitions › Definitions › PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.1. Statewide average weekly wage
citation: PA Stat § PA ST 77 P.S. § 25.1. Statewide average weekly wage (2023)
content:
The term “the Statewide average weekly wage,” as used in this act, means that amount
   which shall be determined annually by the department for each calendar year on the
   basis of employment covered by the Pennsylvania Unemployment Compensation Law1for the twelve-month period ending June 30 preceding the calendar year.
